verdict.rationale: Publishing upfront account, credential and identity-proofing requirements is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack holds only two HTTP 403 responses on robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. No page content was fetched, so nothing shows the service stating its prerequisites before filing begins. Confidence is low because the wall blocked inspection rather than showing the capability is missing.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
